queries.query: When are subscription invoices due for payment?
When may either party terminate for a material breach?
How quickly must a personal data breach be reported?
What security safeguards must the processor maintain?
What monthly availability target is in the SLA?
How are service credits applied for availability shortfalls?

retrieval_evaluation.note: Six hand-authored queries over fictional contracts; this is retrieval smoke evaluation, not legal correctness validation.

implemented_capabilities: Markdown and text contract ingestion with clause metadata
Lexical reranking with content and title overlap
Optional Sentence Transformers dense embedding retrieval
Optional CrossEncoder reranking (not exercised in the Colab run)
Clause-level citations and abstention for unmatched queries
CLI, evaluator and fictional legal test corpus
Invoice-query regression test ensures Clause 4.1 ranks first
limitations: The included agreements are fictional and do not state actual legal requirements.
Default vector search is TF-IDF and lexical; optional dense embeddings and cross-encoder reranking require extra model downloads.
Retrieval evaluation uses six hand-authored queries and does not evaluate legal correctness or advice suitability.
The project does not provide legal advice or assess enforceability.
